data.claim: Yes, with two sources. Claude Code subscriptions expose the vendor's own utilization + resets_at for five_hour and seven_day (and per-model weekly) windows: headless stream-json rate_limit_event, the statusline stdin rate_limits, and a stale cache in ~/.claude.json cachedUsageUtilization. Everything else (Kilo kilo.db, vLLM usage/metrics, Claude transcripts, Gemini/API keys) gives token counts only, so day/month/total limits and non-Claude agents need operator-declared budgets. ddflow has no quota/pause today; the natural enforcement is next/claim returning REFUSED (exit 3) with resume_at and no alternatives, computed in the api layer, with usage kept in machine-local state, not the committed log.

data.question: Can ddflow track agent token/session usage per window (5h, day, week, month, total) and pause work at 80% of a limit until the window resets or the operator says continue?

data.text: I want the ddflow project to be able to generically support quotas, to ask the agent and if the agent cannot reply the user for what the quotas will be and to respect them, and if there are agents and LLM with unlimited quotas to not apply any quotas. At 80% by default (unless user requests everything) the items in progress shall pause until the quota limit restarts and then automatically resumes (when the quota is restored, aka after 5h) unless the user say otherwise.

data.alternatives: Stop only new work at 80% and let in-progress finish: rejected by the operator. Store profiles in the committed project log: pushes one account's limits onto every clone and makes several projects disagree about one account. Call the OAuth usage endpoint: freshest reading, but it uses the user's credentials unasked.
data.consequences: Several ddflow projects on one account share one quota. A pause survives an agent's session ending: the item stays leased and paused, and ddflow wait / the loop wakes it at resume_at. Unlimited subjects (local vLLM) never pause. Vendor percent is account-wide, so claude.ai use elsewhere counts; declared budgets cannot see usage outside this machine.
data.context: Operator 2026-09-29 (session s20260929T105507-3319427): ddflow must support quotas generically, ask the agent (else the user) what they are, respect them, skip agents/LLMs with unlimited quotas; at 80% by default (unless the user asks to use everything) items in progress pause until the limit restarts and resume automatically (e.g. after 5h) unless the user says otherwise. Research R-usage-quota: only Claude Code subscriptions expose a vendor percentage and reset time; everything else gives tokens only.
data.decision: (1) A quota PROFILE per subject -- an agent harness+account (claude-code:<account>) or an LLM endpoint (llm:<base_url>): either unlimited, or windows {5h|day|week|month|total, limit, unit tokens|usd|sessions|vendor-percent, reset rolling|fixed}. (2) DISCOVERY: a subject with no profile is an obligation; the agent is asked first (MCP ddflow_quota declare) and answers from what it knows; if it cannot, it records 'unknown' and the operator is asked. Until declared, work is not blocked, only reminded. (3) METERS: prefer the vendor's own percent+reset (Claude Code statusline/stream-json/cache); otherwise count tokens/sessions locally; a reading that cannot be taken is UNAVAILABLE, never zero. (4) ENFORCEMENT at [quota] pause_at (default 0.8; 1.0 = use everything): next/claim refuse with exit 3 and resume_at (never exit 2, which the implement loop reads as done); items in progress PAUSE -- lease kept, expiry suspended, agent stops at a safe point (WIP committed); (5) RESUME automatically once the window resets and a fresh reading is below the threshold; operator 'quota hold' keeps it paused, 'quota continue' overrides now. (6) Profiles and usage samples are per USER account on this machine (~/.config/ddflow, ~/.local/state/ddflow), not the committed log; item pause/resume are project events. (7) ddflow does not call Anthropic's OAuth usage endpoint with the user's credentials.
data.title: Generic usage quotas: declared per agent/LLM (agent first, else the operator), unlimited means none; at 80% new work stops AND in-progress items pause until the window resets, then resume automatically unless the operator says otherwise
Usage quotas: declare per agent/LLM, meter, pause at 80%, resume automatically (D-quotas)

data.body: D-quotas (2). A subject with no profile is an Obligation (footer, brief, session-start hook): 'declare your quota with ddflow_quota declare -- windows or unlimited; if you cannot tell, declare unknown and ask the operator'. declared unknown -> brief/status show 'operator: what are the quotas for <subject>?' until the operator declares. data.body: D-quotas (4),(5). services.quota.evaluate(subject) -> per window {used, limit, fraction, resets_at, source, stale}; unlimited -> never. At fraction >= pause_at for the caller's subject: next and claim return exit 3 with resume_at, reason 'quota', alternatives [] (never exit 2); heartbeat/gate record return a pause signal for items in progress; new events lease.paused {until, window, reason} / lease.resumed: a paused lease does not expire and is not offered to others. Auto-resume at resume_at when a fresh reading is below pause_at (else extend to the next reset); operator 'quota hold' (no auto-resume) / 'quota continue [--until T] [--pause-at X]' overrides, recorded. ddflow wait (B-wait-wake) also wakes at resume_at. Loop detector must not flag a paused queue as stalled.
data.title: Quota enforcement: at pause_at refuse new work and PAUSE items in progress; resume automatically at the window reset

data.body: D-quotas (4),(5). implement.md: a quota pause (exit 3, reason quota, resume_at) is neither Done nor take-an-alternative: commit WIP in the worktree, then wait until resume_at (Claude Code: ddflow wait in the background / ScheduleWakeup chained, each <= 3600s) and continue the same item; operator 'hold' keeps it stopped, 'continue' resumes now. Harnesses with no wake primitive stop and print resume_at. claudehooks: optional PreToolUse hook (generalised install for any event) that blocks tool calls while this agent's subject is paused, and a StopFailure hook recording error=rate_limit as a hit.
data.title: Agents honour a quota pause: implement loop pauses at a safe point and resumes; Claude Code hook stops tool use while paused
